units.source_text: 我真的有些累了，于是就和拉卟一起跟随长老沿着弥漫着馨香的走廊进入一个房间。

en.t: I was truly somewhat tired, so I followed the elder with Rapp down a corridor filled with fragrance and into a room.

units.source_text: 房间角落里，有一座黑色的维纳斯女神塑像，塑像面供奉着一束野葡萄。

en.t: In the corner of the room stood a black statue of the goddess Venus, and before it a bunch of wild grapes had been offered.

units.source_text: 我原先认为想僧房不会有什么装饰，所以对此有些意外。

en.t: I had originally thought that a monk's cell would have no decorations, so I found this somewhat unexpected.

units.source_text: 长老可能是从我神态看出了我的心情，在我没落座之前，就抱歉地说道：

en.t: The elder probably read my feelings from my expression, and before I had even sat down, he said apologetically:

units.source_text: “请不要忘记我们的信仰是生活教。

en.t: Please do not forget that our faith is the religion of life.

units.source_text: 我们的神——‘生命之树’的教义是‘生机勃勃地活下去’。

en.t: The doctrine of our god, the Tree of Life, is to live on full of vitality.

units.source_text: ……拉卟君，你让这位先生读过我们的《圣经》了吗？”

en.t: ... Rapp, have you had this gentleman read our Bible?
